buildings_basis_complete.name: buildings_basis_complete
buildings_basis_complete.value:
("buildings"."purchase_price_cents" IS NULL AND "buildings"."land_basis_cents" IS NULL
          AND "buildings"."building_basis_cents" IS NULL)
        OR ("buildings"."purchase_price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "buildings"."land_basis_cents" IS NOT NULL
          AND "buildings"."building_basis_cents" IS NOT NULL
          AND "buildings"."land_basis_cents" + "buildings"."building_basis_cents"
            = "buildings"."purchase_price_cents" + coalesce("buildings"."closing_costs_cents", 0))

rent_periods_org_unmarked.name: rent_periods_org_unmarked
rent_periods_org_unmarked.where: amount_received_cents IS NULL AND NOT vacant

tasks_confirmed_is_booked.name: tasks_confirmed_is_booked
tasks_confirmed_is_booked.value:
"tasks"."confirmed_on" IS NULL OR (
        "tasks"."status" IN ('scheduled', 'done')
        AND ("tasks"."assignee_contact_id" IS NOT NULL OR "tasks"."assignee_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )
